title: Data-role skills overlap
goal: A career coach can identify shared and role-specific skills across three data roles.

rubric.must: Three labelled overlapping sets are visibly present.
The central three-way overlap is visibly labelled Data literacy.
Pairwise overlaps visibly show SQL, Statistics, and Python.
Each role has a visible role-specific skill.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG meets all five rules, while the picture lacks the required central Data literacy label and pairwise SQL, Statistics, and Python labels.
